description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents... “HP 13W Vista Blue”, a true Gulf-front gem nestled in the sought-after High Pointe Resort. “Vista Blue” is a ground-level condo offering unbeatable beachfront access, luxury amenities and breathtaking Emerald Coast views. This beautifully appointed 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom retreat comfortably sleeps 6 and is thoughtfully designed for effortless coastal living. Step from your private patio onto the beach boardwalk, soak up the sun beside the lagoon-style pool or savor fresh seafood just steps away at Crabby Steve’s. Whether you’re seeking family beach time or a peaceful escape, “Vista Blue” delivers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience and classic 30A charm. Keep reading to discover more... 👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Prime Gulf-Front Location - Direct beachfront access with unobstructed views from your private patioResort Amenities Galore - Lagoon-style pool, hot tub, Crabby Steve’s restaurant, tennis, pickleball and moreGround Floor Convenience - Skip the stairs and head straight from your patio to the sandSpacious 2-Bedroom Layout - Sleeps 6 with two private suites and plenty of room to unwindFully Equipped Kitchen - Stainless steel appliances and bar seating for 3Private Gulf-Front Patio - Lounge chairs plus al fresco dining for two with front-row sunset viewsWasher and Dryer - Full-size laundry tucked away for easy beach day refreshes*** LIVING AREAS ***The open-concept living room invites relaxation with comfortable coastal decor and seamless Gulf-front views. Perfect for family movie nights or morning coffee with ocean breezes.Plush seating and flat-screen TV for downtime after the beachWall-to-wall windows showcase sparkling Gulf viewsEasy access to the patio for indoor-outdoor flow*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Designed for both casual bites and family-style dinners, the kitchen is fully equipped and beautifully styled.Stainless steel appliances and generous counter spaceBar seating for 3 at the kitchen islandDining table with seating for 6 just steps from the kitchen*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Gulf-Front Primary King Suite - King bed, flat-screen TV, patio access and En-Suite with dual vanities and walk-in showerQueen Guest Suite - Two queen beds, flat-screen TV and En-Suite with single vanity, shower/tub combo and secondary hall access*** OUTDOOR SPACES & RESORT AMENITIES ***Step directly from your private patio onto the boardwalk and into resort-style bliss. High Pointe is known for its exceptional amenities and unbeatable beachfront location.Gulf-front patio with lounge chairs and dining for 2Lagoon-style community pool with waterfall, kiddie pool and hot tubPrivate beach access via boardwalk steps from your doorOn-site dining at Crabby Steve’s - beachfront, casual and deliciousTennis courts, 4 pickleball courts, shuffleboard and a kids’ playgroundBBQ grills (charcoal) and green spaces for family fun*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in the heart of Seacrest Beach, High Pointe Resort offers seamless access to some of 30A’s most beloved communities and attractions.Peddlers Pavilion - Just across the street! Enjoy live music, food vendors and shoppingRosemary Beach - 6-minute walk to charming cobblestone streets and boutique cafésAlys Beach - Less than a mile away, known for its serene beauty and striking architectureCarillon Downtown & Market Street - 8-minute drive for additional shopping and dining*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfersBicycle rentals are available for an additional fee and managed by La Dolce VitaLSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest (including High Pointe) or Alys BeachHigh Pointe HOA does not allow unregistered guests or visitors on-site*** YOUR STAY — OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE ***TDT #: 206792
